You are a code-feature worker (test-first) implementing ONE bash script for the loop-stack board pipeline.
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-stack-session repo (branch i52-obsidian-board-mvp); edit files here directly. Do not push. Do NOT git commit at any point; leave every change uncommitted in the worktree (the harness exports your diff and the orchestrator applies and commits it).

You own ONLY this path; do not create, edit, or delete anything else:
- Create: scripts/board.sh

The acceptance check tests/board/discovery.sh is FIXED and AUTHORITATIVE; the harness overwrites any copy with the canonical test and runs it against your script. Do not try to satisfy it by editing it. It is reproduced verbatim at the end of this spec so you can develop test-first.

PORTABILITY (hard constraint): target macOS stock /bin/bash 3.2. No associative arrays, no ${var,,}, no grep -P, no GNU-only flags. Use `set -uo pipefail`. This matches the constraint scripts/tracker.sh already carries.

GIT SIGNALS ARE LOCAL ONLY, NEVER NETWORK: never run `git fetch`. `uncommitted` and `ahead` are current; `behind` is as-of-last-fetch.

GOAL: scripts/board.sh discovers git repos under three scan roots and emits a Discovery TSV; a bare invocation wires the full three-stage pipeline.

Discovery TSV (tab-separated, one row per INCLUDED git repo, NO header, exactly 9 fields, this order):
1 repo_path          absolute path to repo root
2 repo_key           path relative to $HOME, e.g. create/loops/loop-stack-session
3 scan_root          which root it was found under
4 conforming         yes when config/repo-state.md exists at repo root, else no
5 included           yes when the his-work filter admits it, else no
6 last_commit_epoch  unix seconds of HEAD commit (0 if no commits)
7 uncommitted        count of `git status --porcelain` lines
8 ahead              commits ahead of upstream (-1 when no upstream configured)
9 behind_fetch       <count>:<fetch_epoch> behind as of last fetch, or empty when no upstream

CONFIG (environment, with defaults): LOOP_BOARD_ROOTS (default "$HOME/create $HOME/projects $HOME/repos"), LOOP_BOARD_OWNER (default jroethel), LOOP_BOARD_HOME, LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX, LOOP_BOARD_CSS. Discovery is git-only and does NOT call the tracker.

HIS-WORK FILTER: include a repo when conforming (config/repo-state.md exists) OR the extracted origin owner equals LOOP_BOARD_OWNER OR uncommitted>0 OR ahead>0.
OWNER EXTRACTION from `git -C <repo> remote get-url origin` (handles HTTPS and SSH):
  sed -E 's#^[a-zA-Z]+://##; s#^[^@/]*@##; s#^[^/:]+[:/]##; s#/.*$##'
  (yields jroethel from both https://github.com/jroethel/x.git and git@github.com:jroethel/x.git).

BEHAVIOR:
- Walk each root in LOOP_BOARD_ROOTS to depth 2, NO symlink following: `find "$root" -maxdepth 2 -name .git -type d` and take each parent. Do not use find -H.
- repo_key = repo path with the leading $HOME/ stripped.
- last_commit_epoch: `git -C <repo> log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null` (empty result -> 0).
- uncommitted: `git -C <repo> status --porcelain | grep -c .` (0 when clean).
- ahead/behind_fetch: when an upstream exists (`git -C <repo> rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u}` succeeds), ahead = `git -C <repo> rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD`, behind count = `git -C <repo> rev-list --count HEAD..@{u}`, fetch epoch from the mtime of <repo>/.git/FETCH_HEAD (`stat -f %m` on macOS, 0 when that file is absent). With no upstream: ahead=-1, behind_fetch empty. Never run git fetch.
- Non-git directories under a root are counted per root and reported to stderr as comment lines: `# skipped: N non-git dirs under <root>`.

SUBCOMMANDS:
- `scripts/board.sh discover` prints the Discovery TSV to stdout (one row per included repo) and the per-root skip counts to stderr.
- Bare `scripts/board.sh` runs the full pipeline: discover | scripts/board-cards.sh | scripts/board-render-obsidian.sh, forwarding the skip counts to the renderer via a temp file. This task implements the `discover` subcommand and the pipeline wiring; the two downstream scripts may not exist yet - the wiring calls them by relative path.
- On a bare (rendering) invocation with LOOP_BOARD_HOME unset or empty, fail with a `board:` prefixed message.

HOW TO RUN (from worktree root): `bash tests/board/discovery.sh` must exit 0.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: scripts/board.sh only; leave it uncommitted for patch export.
If anything is ambiguous, take the most conservative reading consistent with the acceptance test and note it at the end of your final message.

--- VERBATIM ACCEPTANCE TEST (tests/board/discovery.sh) ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# board.sh discover walks roots to depth 2, emits 9-field rows only for included git repos,
# excludes clean third-party clones (HTTPS and SSH remotes), includes dirty ones, and reports
# non-git dirs as skip comments.
set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
fail() { echo "FAIL: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkrepo() { mkdir -p "$1"; git -C "$1" init -q; git -C "$1" config user.email a@b.c; git -C "$1" config user.name t; }
commit() { ( cd "$1"; echo x > f; git add f; git commit -qm c ); }

root="$tmp/create"
mkrepo "$root/conforming"; mkdir -p "$root/conforming/config"; echo k > "$root/conforming/config/repo-state.md"; commit "$root/conforming"
mkrepo "$root/mine"; git -C "$root/mine" remote add origin https://github.com/jroethel/mine.git; commit "$root/mine"
mkrepo "$root/mine-ssh"; git -C "$root/mine-ssh" remote add origin git@github.com:jroethel/x.git; commit "$root/mine-ssh"
mkrepo "$root/thirdparty"; git -C "$root/thirdparty" remote add origin https://github.com/someoneelse/lib.git; commit "$root/thirdparty"
mkrepo "$root/tp-ssh"; git -C "$root/tp-ssh" remote add origin git@github.com:someoneelse/lib.git; commit "$root/tp-ssh"
mkrepo "$root/dirty"; git -C "$root/dirty" remote add origin https://github.com/someoneelse/dirty.git; commit "$root/dirty"; echo change >> "$root/dirty/f"
mkdir -p "$root/notgit"                                  # non-git dir, must be skipped and counted
mkdir -p "$root/nest/deep"; mkrepo "$root/nest/deep"; git -C "$root/nest/deep" remote add origin git@github.com:jroethel/deep.git; commit "$root/nest/deep"

out="$(LOOP_BOARD_ROOTS="$root" LOOP_BOARD_OWNER=jroethel bash "$REPO/scripts/board.sh" discover 2>"$tmp/err")" || fail "discover exited non-zero"

field() { awk -F'\t' -v k="$1" -v c="$2" '$2==k{print $c}' <<<"$out"; }
grep -q "create/conforming" <<<"$out" || fail "conforming repo missing"
[ "$(field create/conforming 4)" = yes ] || fail "conforming flag wrong"
grep -q "create/mine" <<<"$out" || fail "https owner-matched repo missing"
grep -q "create/mine-ssh" <<<"$out" || fail "ssh owner-matched repo missing"
grep -q "create/thirdparty" <<<"$out" && fail "clean https third-party clone should be excluded"
grep -q "create/tp-ssh" <<<"$out" && fail "clean ssh third-party clone should be excluded"
grep -q "create/dirty" <<<"$out" || fail "dirty third-party clone should be included (uncommitted)"
[ "$(field create/dirty 7)" -ge 1 ] || fail "uncommitted count not reported"
grep -q "create/nest/deep" <<<"$out" || fail "depth-2 repo missing"
awk -F'\t' 'NF!=9{exit 3}' <<<"$out" || fail "a row does not have 9 fields"
grep -qE 'skipped: [0-9]+ non-git' "$tmp/err" || fail "non-git dirs not reported to stderr"
echo "PASS: discovery includes/excludes correctly over https+ssh, 9 fields, skip count reported"
